QUOTE: "**Compile time.** Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` together. The macros must be set as a pair. When both are present, `platform.c` drops the runtime setter entirely, so calling it fails to link."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair set through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. It also says the macro configuration removes the runtime setter, which makes the two mutually exclusive.
